==== generated/debian.d/core/shared.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GENERATED FILE, do not edit.
set -euxo pipefail

MODDIR=/ctx/modules/core/shared
export MODDIR

mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/lib/dpkg /var/cache/apt/archives/partial
apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y curl git
apt-get clean
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
==== generated/debian.graph.md
# Debian capability graph

GENERATED FILE, do not edit.

An arrow points from a provider to what needs it, dotted for `after`,
which orders the build without requiring anything. Layers build left to
right.

```mermaid
graph LR
    base["ghcr.io/bootcrew/debian-bootc:latest"]
    m0["core/shared"]
```

## Capabilities

| Name | Kind | Provided by | Required by | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `initramfs-generation` | capability | `base` |  |  |
